filesDescription: Upload, share, and manage files in your storage.
serviceDescription: Connection and runtime information for your Condite service.
uploadHint: Your API key limits apply. Files go directly to your storage.
name: Name
emptyHint: Upload a file to get started.
noMatches: No matching files on this page.
deleteHint: This removes the file from storage. This action cannot be undone.
linkHint: Anyone with this link can access the file until it expires.
copyFailed: Copy failed. Select and copy the link below.
error: The request failed. Check the connection and try again.
serviceHint: Health reflects the service response, not a full storage audit.
tooLarge: This file exceeds your API key limits.
failedUpload: Upload failed. Refresh files to find the pending record; retry confirmation or delete it.
uploadAgain: Choose the file again to retry an upload.
temporary: Uploads stay private until shared. Condite deletes expired files and links while online.
noJs: File information is server-rendered. Enable JavaScript for file actions.
draftHint: Condite adds download links to the original channel draft.
automatic: Discord within its limit, Condite for larger files
limitOverride: Discord limit override in MiB (0 = automatic)
draftAdded: Condite links added to the original channel draft
shareHint: Anyone with a share link can download this file. Each link can be revoked separately. A share cannot outlive the file.
retentionHint: Choose when Condite should delete this file and all its shared copies. Intervals adjust the current expiry, or today for a file kept forever.
cleanupHint: Condite removes expired links every minute while online. Downloads and third-party cached copies cannot be recalled.
invalidExpiry: Choose a valid future expiry date or Never.
deletionWarning: This date has passed. Confirm that you want to delete the file and all its shared copies.
apiKeyDescription: Stored locally in Vencord settings. Sent only to the configured Condite API.
